CustomField.inlineHelpText: A named dimension: PRODUCT_FAMILY, CHARGE_TYPE, QUOTE_LINE_GROUP, BUNDLE, TRANSACTION_TYPE or INDUSTRY. Use this for values the generator computes rather than reads - BUNDLE and TRANSACTION_TYPE have no single field behind them. For anything that is a plain field, set Field Path instead and avoid the Apex change. Set one or the other, not both.
CustomField.label: Dimension
